description.text: Course InformationThis program aims at cultivating students to possess good foundation of mathematics and basic engineering theory, to have the ability of conducting the designing, manufacturing, maintenance and repairing aircraft and engine, to be qualified to work as the advanced technicians in the future in the field of aeronautical and mechanical engineering industries. The main courses in this program consists of higher mathematics, engineering mechanics, fluid mechanics, engineering thermodynamics, mechanical principles and design, design of aircraft, aero engine, design of aircraft controlling system, the basic and application of finite mega, aeronautical manufacturing technology.

duration.text: The Aeronautical Engineering at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: The applicants must fill in and provide the following documents truly, correctly and completely (in duplicates).1. Application form: The form should be duplicated in either Chinese or English.2. Highest diploma, including senior high school diploma or bachelor’s degree certificate needed in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.3. Academic transcripts: Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.4. A study or research plan. Applicants for postgraduate degrees are required to submit a study or research plan in Chinese or in English.5. Recommendation letters: Applicants for postgraduate studies must submit two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors.Note: Application documents will not be returned regardless of the result of application

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:-Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.-Applicants for master’s degree program must have bachelor’s degree and be under the age of 35.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
